The quote showed GOOGL at $171.12 (bid $171.10 / ask $171.14) as of 15:05 UTC on 2024-11-06, and the account holds $100,000 cash with no existing GOOGL position, so a purchase was affordable without moving any money out. Alphabet's FY2023 10-K (filed 2024-01-31) showed revenue of $307,394M, net income of $73,795M, diluted EPS of $5.80, and operating cash flow of $101,746M — a large, cash-generative business at roughly 30x trailing earnings, which I judged a reasonable long-term entry for a long-term holder. I therefore placed a single buy limit order for 140 shares at $171.50, about 0.2% above the last price (well within "close to market"), for a notional of ~$24,010 — under the $25,000 per-order cap and leaving total same-day purchases at $24,010, under the $50,000 daily cap. No sells were made and no funds were withdrawn.
